nl.tagline: Muziekapp die sporen splitst en akkoorden herkent

en.tagline: Music app that splits tracks and detects chords
en.description: Moises is an app for musicians. You take instruments or vocals out of a song. The app also detects chords and tempo. That way you practise at your own pace.
bestFor: Playing along without your instrument in the mix
limitations: Many features are in the paid plan
